verses.1:1: Since indeed many have attempted to put in order an account of the things that have been completed among us,
verses.1:2: just as those who from the beginning saw for themselves and were servants of the word handed them down to us,
verses.1:3: it has seemed right to me also, having carefully traced all things from the first, to write to you in order, most excellent Theophilus,
verses.1:4: so that you may know the truth of those words about which you have been instructed.
verses.1:5: In the days of Herod, king of Judea, there was a certain priest by the name of Zechariah, from the division of Abijah, and his wife was from the daughters of Aaron, and her name was Elizabeth.
verses.1:6: Now both of them were righteous before God, walking in all the commandments and ordinances of the Lord without reproach.
verses.1:7: And they had no son, because Elizabeth was barren, and both of them were advanced in their days.
verses.1:8: Now it happened that while he was performing the priestly office in the order of his division before God,
verses.1:9: according to the custom of the priesthood, it fell to him by lot, upon entering the temple of the Lord, to offer incense.
verses.1:10: And the entire multitude of the people was praying outside at the hour of incense.
verses.1:11: Now an angel of the Lord appeared to him, standing at the right side of the altar of incense.
verses.1:12: And Zechariah was troubled at the sight, and fear rushed upon him.
verses.1:13: But the angel spoke to him, "Do not be afraid, Zechariah, because your supplication has been heard, and your wife Elizabeth will bear a son for you, and you will call his name John.
verses.1:14: And there will be joy and exultation for you, and many will rejoice at his birth.
verses.1:15: For he will be great in the presence of the Lord, and he will not drink wine or strong drink, and he will be filled with the Holy Spirit even from his mother's womb.
verses.1:16: And he will turn many of the sons of Israel to the Lord their God,
verses.1:17: and he himself will go ahead before Him in the spirit and power of Elijah, so that he may turn the hearts of fathers to their children, and the unbelieving to the prudence of the righteous, to prepare for the Lord a perfected people."
verses.1:18: And Zechariah said to the angel, "How am I to know this? For I am an old man, and my wife has advanced in her days."
verses.1:19: And answering, the angel said to him, "I am Gabriel, who stand before God, and I was sent to speak to you and to proclaim this good news to you.
verses.1:20: And look, you will be silent and will not be able to speak until the day on which these things happen, because you did not believe my words, which will be fulfilled in their own time."
verses.1:21: And the people were waiting for Zechariah, and they were marveling that he was delaying in the temple.
verses.1:22: But upon coming out, he was not able to speak to them, and they recognized that he had seen a vision in the temple. And he himself was signaling to them, and he remained mute.
verses.1:23: And it happened that when the days of his service were completed, he went away to his house.
verses.1:24: Now after these days, Elizabeth his wife conceived, and she kept herself hidden for five months, saying,
verses.1:25: "So the Lord has done for me in the days in which He looked with favor to remove my disgrace among people."
verses.1:26: Now in the sixth month, the angel Gabriel was sent by God into a city of Galilee whose name was Nazareth,
verses.1:27: to a virgin betrothed to a man whose name was Joseph, from the house of David; and the name of the virgin was Mary.
verses.1:28: And entering in to her, the angel said, "Greetings, full of grace; the Lord is with you. Blessed are you among women."
verses.1:29: And when she had heard this, she was troubled at his word, and she was reflecting on what kind of greeting this was.
verses.1:30: And the angel spoke to her, "Do not be afraid, Mary, for you have found grace with God.
verses.1:31: Look, you will conceive in your womb and bear a son, and you will call His name Jesus.
verses.1:32: He will be great and will be called Son of the Most High, and the Lord God will give to Him the throne of David His father, and He will reign in the house of Jacob forever,
verses.1:33: and there will be no end to His kingdom."
verses.1:34: Now Mary said to the angel, "How will this happen, since I do not know a man?"
verses.1:35: And answering, the angel said to her, "The Holy Spirit will come upon you, and the power of the Most High will overshadow you. Therefore also the Holy One who will be born from you will be called the Son of God.
verses.1:36: And look, Elizabeth your relative, she also has conceived a son in her old age, and this is the sixth month for her who is called barren,
verses.1:37: for no word will be impossible with God."
verses.1:38: Then Mary said, "Here is the maidservant of the Lord; may it happen to me according to your word." And the angel withdrew from her.
verses.1:39: Now arising in those days, Mary went away with haste into the hill country, to a city of Judah,
verses.1:40: and she entered into Zechariah's house and greeted Elizabeth.
verses.1:41: And it happened that when Elizabeth heard the greeting of Mary, the infant leaped in her womb, and Elizabeth was filled with the Holy Spirit,
verses.1:42: and she exclaimed in a loud voice and said, "Blessed are you among women, and blessed is the fruit of your womb.
verses.1:43: And how does this fall to me, that the mother of my Lord should come to me?
verses.1:44: For look, as soon as the voice of your greeting came to my ears, the infant in my womb leaped in joy.
verses.1:45: And blessed are you who have believed, because the things that were spoken to you by the Lord will be brought to completion."
verses.1:46: And Mary spoke, "My soul magnifies the Lord,
verses.1:47: and my spirit has exulted in God my Savior.
verses.1:48: For He has looked upon the lowliness of His maidservant; for look, from this time on all generations will call me blessed,
verses.1:49: because the One who is mighty has done great things for me, and His name is holy,
verses.1:50: and His mercy is from generation to generations for those who fear Him.
verses.1:51: He has displayed might with His arm; He has scattered the proud in the thought of their heart.
verses.1:52: He has brought down the mighty from the throne and has exalted the lowly.
verses.1:53: He has filled those who hunger with good things, and He has sent the rich away empty.
verses.1:54: He has upheld Israel His servant, remembering His mercy,
verses.1:55: just as He spoke to our fathers, to Abraham and to his seed forever."
verses.1:56: Now Mary stayed with her for about three months, and she returned to her own house.
verses.1:57: Now for Elizabeth the time of giving birth was fulfilled, and she bore a son.
verses.1:58: And her neighbors and relatives heard that the Lord had magnified His mercy with her, and they were rejoicing with her.
verses.1:59: And it happened on the eighth day that they came to circumcise the child, and they were calling him by the name of his father, Zechariah.
verses.1:60: And answering, his mother said, "Not at all, but he will be called John."
verses.1:61: And they said to her, "There is no one among your kin who is called by this name."
verses.1:62: Now they were signaling to his father what he wanted him to be called.
verses.1:63: And asking for a writing tablet, he wrote, saying, "John is his name." And all of them marveled.
verses.1:64: Now at once his mouth was opened and his tongue released, and he was speaking, blessing God.
verses.1:65: And fear came upon all their neighbors, and throughout all the hill country of Judea all these words were being spread abroad;
verses.1:66: and all who had heard them placed them in their heart, saying, "Who, do you think, will this child be?" For indeed the hand of the Lord was with him.
verses.1:67: And Zechariah his father was filled with the Holy Spirit, and he prophesied, saying,
verses.1:68: "Blessed be the Lord God of Israel, because He has visited and accomplished the redemption of His people,
verses.1:69: and He has lifted up for us a horn of salvation in the house of David His servant,
verses.1:70: just as He spoke through the mouth of His holy prophets who have been from ancient times:
verses.1:71: salvation from our enemies and out of the hand of all those who hate us,
verses.1:72: to show mercy with our fathers and to be mindful of His holy covenant,
verses.1:73: the oath that He swore to Abraham our father, that He would give to us,
verses.1:74: that without fear, freed from the hand of our enemies, we may serve Him
verses.1:75: in holiness and righteousness in His presence, all our days.
verses.1:76: And you, child, will be called a prophet of the Most High, for you will go ahead before the face of the Lord to prepare His ways,
verses.1:77: to give His people knowledge of salvation, for the forgiveness of their sins,
verses.1:78: through the depths of the mercy of our God, in which the Dawn from on high has visited us,
verses.1:79: to illuminate those who sit in darkness and in the shadow of death, to direct our feet into the way of peace."
verses.1:80: Now the child was growing and being strengthened in spirit, and he was in the deserts until the day of his appearing to Israel.
verses.2:1: Now it came about in those days that a decree went out from Caesar Augustus that the entire world should be registered.
verses.2:2: This first registration was carried out by Quirinius, governor of Syria.
verses.2:3: And all were going to register, each one to his own city.
verses.2:4: Now Joseph also went up from Galilee, from the city of Nazareth, into Judea, into the city of David, which is called Bethlehem, since he was from the house and family of David,
verses.2:5: to register with Mary, his betrothed wife, who was pregnant.
verses.2:6: Now it came about, while they were there, that the days were fulfilled for her to give birth.
verses.2:7: And she gave birth to her firstborn son, wrapped Him in strips of cloth, and laid Him down in a manger, because there was no place for them in the inn.
verses.2:8: And there were shepherds in that same region staying awake and guarding the watches of the night over their flock.
verses.2:9: And look, an angel of the Lord stood beside them, and the brightness of God shone around them, and they feared with a great fear.
verses.2:10: And the angel said to them, "Do not be afraid, for look, I announce to you good news of a great joy that will be for all the people,
verses.2:11: because today a Savior has been born for you, who is Christ the Lord, in the city of David.
verses.2:12: And this is a sign for you: you will find an infant wrapped in strips of cloth and placed in a manger."
verses.2:13: And suddenly there was with the angel a multitude of the heavenly army, praising God and saying,
verses.2:14: "Glory to God in the highest, and on earth peace to people of good will."
verses.2:15: And it came about, when the angels departed from them into heaven, that the shepherds were speaking to one another, "Let us cross over to Bethlehem and see this word that has come about, which the Lord has shown us."
verses.2:16: And they came hurrying, and they found Mary and Joseph, and the infant placed in the manger.
verses.2:17: Now upon seeing, they came to know about the word that had been told to them concerning this child.
verses.2:18: And all who heard marveled, even at the things that had been told to them by the shepherds.
verses.2:19: Mary, however, was keeping all these words, weighing them in her heart.
verses.2:20: And the shepherds returned, glorifying and praising God in all that they had heard and seen, just as it was spoken to them.
verses.2:21: And after eight days were completed for the child to be circumcised, His name was called Jesus, which had been named by the angel before He was conceived in the womb.
verses.2:22: And after the days of her purification were fulfilled according to the law of Moses, they brought Him to Jerusalem to present Him to the Lord,
verses.2:23: just as it is written in the law of the Lord, "Every male opening the womb will be called holy to the Lord,"
verses.2:24: and to offer a sacrifice according to what was stated in the law of the Lord, a pair of turtledoves or two young pigeons.
verses.2:25: And look, there was a man in Jerusalem whose name was Simeon; and this man was righteous and devout, waiting for the consolation of Israel, and the Holy Spirit was in him.
verses.2:26: And he had received an answer from the Holy Spirit that he would not see death unless he first saw the Christ of the Lord.
verses.2:27: And he came in the Spirit into the temple. And when His parents brought in the child Jesus to do for Him according to the custom of the law,
verses.2:28: he himself took Him into his arms, and blessed God, and said,
verses.2:29: "Now You release Your servant, Lord, according to Your word, in peace,
verses.2:30: because my eyes have seen Your salvation,
verses.2:31: which You have prepared before the face of all peoples:
verses.2:32: a light for the revelation of the Gentiles, and the glory of Your people Israel."
verses.2:33: And His father and mother were marveling at the things that were being spoken about Him.
verses.2:34: And Simeon blessed them and said to Mary His mother, "Look, this one is set for the downfall and for the rising of many in Israel, and for a sign that will be spoken against,
verses.2:35: and a sword will pierce through your own soul, so that thoughts from many hearts may be revealed."
verses.2:36: And there was Anna, a prophetess, daughter of Phanuel, of the tribe of Asher; she had advanced in many days, and had lived with her husband seven years from her virginity.
verses.2:37: And she was a widow up to eighty-four years, who did not depart from the temple, serving with fastings and supplications night and day.
verses.2:38: And she, coming up at that very hour, was giving praise to the Lord, and was speaking about Him to all who were waiting for the redemption of Israel.
verses.2:39: And when they had completed everything according to the law of the Lord, they returned to Galilee, to their own city, Nazareth.
verses.2:40: Now the child was growing and becoming strong, full of wisdom, and the grace of God was in Him.
verses.2:41: And His parents went every year to Jerusalem on the solemn day of Passover.
verses.2:42: And when He had become twelve years old, as they went up to Jerusalem according to the custom of the feast day,
verses.2:43: and when the days were completed, as they were returning, the boy Jesus stayed behind in Jerusalem, and His parents did not know it.
verses.2:44: Supposing, however, that He was in the company, they went a day's journey, and were searching for Him among their relatives and acquaintances.
verses.2:45: And not finding Him, they went back to Jerusalem, searching for Him.
verses.2:46: And it came about that after three days they found Him in the temple, sitting in the middle of the teachers, listening to them and questioning them.
verses.2:47: Now all who were listening to Him were astounded at His understanding and His answers.
verses.2:48: And when they saw Him, they were astonished. And His mother said to Him, "Son, why have You treated us like this? Look, Your father and I have been searching for You in sorrow."
verses.2:49: And He said to them, "Why is it that you were searching for Me? Did you not know that I must be in the things that belong to My Father?"
verses.2:50: And they themselves did not understand the word that He spoke to them.
verses.2:51: And He went down with them and came to Nazareth, and was subject to them. And His mother was keeping all these words in her heart.
verses.2:52: And Jesus was advancing in wisdom, in age, and in favor before God and people.
verses.3:1: Now in the fifteenth year of the rule of Tiberius Caesar, while Pontius Pilate was governing Judea, and Herod was tetrarch of Galilee, and his brother Philip was tetrarch of Iturea and of the region of Trachonitis, and Lysanias was tetrarch of Abilene,
verses.3:2: under the high priests Annas and Caiaphas, the word of the Lord came upon John, the son of Zechariah, in the desert.
verses.3:3: And he came into the entire region of the Jordan, proclaiming a baptism of repentance for the forgiveness of sins,
verses.3:4: just as it is written in the book of the words of Isaiah the prophet: "A voice of one crying out in the desert: 'Prepare the way of the Lord; make His paths straight.
verses.3:5: Every valley will be filled, and every mountain and hill will be brought low; and the crooked will become straight, and the rough will become level ways,
verses.3:6: and all flesh will see the salvation of God.'"
verses.3:7: Therefore he was saying to the crowds who were going out to be baptized by him, "Offspring of vipers, who has shown you to flee from the coming wrath?
verses.3:8: Produce therefore fruits worthy of repentance, and do not begin to say, 'We have Abraham as our father.' For I tell you that God is able to raise up children for Abraham from these stones.
verses.3:9: For already the axe is placed at the root of the trees. Therefore every tree not producing good fruit will be cut down and thrown into the fire."
verses.3:10: And the crowds were questioning him, saying, "What then shall we do?"
verses.3:11: And answering, he was saying to them, "Let the one who has two tunics give to the one who has none; and let the one who has food do likewise."
verses.3:12: Now tax collectors also came to be baptized, and they said to him, "Teacher, what shall we do?"
verses.3:13: And he said to them, "Do nothing more than what has been appointed to you."
verses.3:14: And soldiers also were questioning him, saying, "What shall we also do?" And he said to them, "Do not extort from anyone, nor make false accusations, and be content with your pay."
verses.3:15: Now while the people were thinking and all were pondering in their hearts about John, whether perhaps he himself might be the Christ,
verses.3:16: John answered, saying to all, "I indeed baptize you with water, but one stronger than I will come, the strap of whose sandals I am not worthy to untie; He Himself will baptize you in the Holy Spirit and fire,
verses.3:17: whose winnowing fork is in His hand, and He will cleanse His threshing floor and gather the wheat into His granary, but the chaff He will burn up with unquenchable fire."
verses.3:18: With many other exhortations indeed, he was proclaiming the good news to the people.
verses.3:19: But Herod the tetrarch, when he was rebuked by him about Herodias, his brother's wife, and about all the evils that Herod had done,
verses.3:20: added this also on top of everything, and locked John up in prison.
verses.3:21: Now it happened that while all the people were being baptized, and when Jesus had been baptized and was praying, heaven was opened,
verses.3:22: and the Holy Spirit descended in bodily form like a dove upon Him; and a voice came from heaven: "You are My beloved Son; in You I have taken delight."
verses.3:23: And Jesus Himself was about thirty years old when He began, the son, as was supposed, of Joseph, who was the son of Heli, who was the son of Matthat,
verses.3:24: who was the son of Levi, who was the son of Melchi, who was the son of Jannai, who was the son of Joseph,
verses.3:25: who was the son of Mattathias, who was the son of Amos, who was the son of Nahum, who was the son of Esli, who was the son of Naggai,
verses.3:26: who was the son of Maath, who was the son of Mattathias, who was the son of Semei, who was the son of Joseph, who was the son of Judah,
verses.3:27: who was the son of Joanna, who was the son of Rhesa, who was the son of Zerubbabel, who was the son of Shealtiel, who was the son of Neri,
verses.3:28: who was the son of Melchi, who was the son of Addi, who was the son of Cosam, who was the son of Elmadam, who was the son of Er,
verses.3:29: who was the son of Joshua, who was the son of Eliezer, who was the son of Jorim, who was the son of Matthat, who was the son of Levi,
verses.3:30: who was the son of Simeon, who was the son of Judah, who was the son of Joseph, who was the son of Jonah, who was the son of Eliakim,
verses.3:31: who was the son of Melea, who was the son of Menna, who was the son of Mattatha, who was the son of Nathan, who was the son of David,
verses.3:32: who was the son of Jesse, who was the son of Obed, who was the son of Boaz, who was the son of Salmon, who was the son of Nahshon,
verses.3:33: who was the son of Amminadab, who was the son of Ram, who was the son of Hezron, who was the son of Perez, who was the son of Judah,
verses.3:34: who was the son of Jacob, who was the son of Isaac, who was the son of Abraham, who was the son of Terah, who was the son of Nahor,
verses.3:35: who was the son of Serug, who was the son of Reu, who was the son of Peleg, who was the son of Eber, who was the son of Shelah,
verses.3:36: who was the son of Cainan, who was the son of Arphaxad, who was the son of Shem, who was the son of Noah, who was the son of Lamech,
verses.3:37: who was the son of Methuselah, who was the son of Enoch, who was the son of Jared, who was the son of Mahalalel, who was the son of Kenan,
verses.3:38: who was the son of Enosh, who was the son of Seth, who was the son of Adam, who was the son of God.
verses.4:1: Now Jesus, full of the Holy Spirit, returned from the Jordan, and was led by the Spirit into the wilderness
verses.4:2: for forty days, and was tempted by the devil. And He ate nothing in those days; and when they were completed, He grew hungry.
verses.4:3: Then the devil said to Him, "If You are the Son of God, say to this stone that it become bread."
verses.4:4: And Jesus replied to him, "It is written, 'Man does not live by bread alone, but by every word of God.'"
verses.4:5: And the devil brought Him onto a high mountain and showed Him all the kingdoms of the world in a moment of time,
verses.4:6: and said to Him, "To You I will give all this authority and their glory, because they have been handed over to me, and I give them to whomever I wish.
verses.4:7: Therefore, if You worship before me, all of them will be Yours."
verses.4:8: And answering, Jesus said to him, "It is written, 'You shall worship the Lord your God, and you shall serve Him alone.'"
verses.4:9: And he brought Him into Jerusalem, and placed Him on the pinnacle of the temple, and said to Him, "If You are the Son of God, cast Yourself down from here.
verses.4:10: For it is written, 'He has commanded His angels concerning You, to protect You,'
verses.4:11: and, 'In their hands they will lift You up, so that You may not by chance strike Your foot against a stone.'"
verses.4:12: And answering, Jesus said to him, "It has been said, 'You shall not tempt the Lord your God.'"
verses.4:13: And when every temptation had been completed, the devil withdrew from Him for a time.
verses.4:14: And Jesus returned in the power of the Spirit into Galilee, and a report went out throughout the entire region concerning Him.
verses.4:15: And He Himself was teaching in their synagogues and was magnified by everyone.
verses.4:16: And He came to Nazareth, where He had been raised, and entered the synagogue on the Sabbath day according to His custom, and rose to read.
verses.4:17: And the scroll of Isaiah the prophet was handed to Him. And when He unrolled the scroll, He found the place where it was written:
verses.4:18: "The Spirit of the Lord is upon Me, because He has anointed Me; He has sent Me to announce good news to the poor, to heal the brokenhearted,
verses.4:19: to proclaim freedom to the captives and sight to the blind, to let the crushed go in freedom, to proclaim the acceptable year of the Lord and the day of retribution."
verses.4:20: And when He had rolled up the scroll, He returned it to the attendant and sat down. And the eyes of everyone in the synagogue were gazing intently at Him.
verses.4:21: Then He began to say to them, "Today this scripture has been fulfilled in your ears."
verses.4:22: And all were bearing witness to Him, and marveling at the words of grace that were proceeding from His mouth, and they were saying, "Is this not the son of Joseph?"
verses.4:23: And He said to them, "Certainly you will say this proverb to Me: 'Physician, heal Yourself! All the things we have heard were done in Capernaum, do here also in Your homeland.'"
verses.4:24: Then He said, "Amen, I tell you that no prophet is accepted in his own homeland.
verses.4:25: In truth I say to you, there were many widows in the days of Elijah in Israel, when the sky was closed for three years and six months, when a great famine arose in all the land,
verses.4:26: and to none of them was Elijah sent, except to Zarephath of Sidon, to a woman who was a widow.
verses.4:27: And there were many lepers in Israel under Elisha the prophet, and not one of them was cleansed except Naaman the Syrian."
verses.4:28: And all in the synagogue were filled with anger as they heard these things.
verses.4:29: And they rose up and drove Him outside the city, and brought Him as far as the brow of the mountain on which their city had been built, so that they might hurl Him headlong.
verses.4:30: But He Himself, passing through the midst of them, went on.
verses.4:31: And He went down into Capernaum, a city of Galilee, and there He was teaching them on the Sabbaths.
verses.4:32: And they were astounded at His teaching, because His speech was with authority.
verses.4:33: And in the synagogue there was a man having an unclean demon, and he cried out in a loud voice,
verses.4:34: saying, "Leave us alone! What do we have to do with You, Jesus the Nazarene? Have You come to destroy us? I know You, who You are: the Holy One of God."
verses.4:35: And Jesus rebuked him, saying, "Be silent, and come out of him." And when the demon had thrown him into the middle, it came out of him and did not harm him at all.
verses.4:36: And dread came upon all, and they were conversing with one another, saying, "What is this word, that with authority and power He commands unclean spirits, and they come out?"
verses.4:37: And the report concerning Him was spreading into every place of the region.
verses.4:38: Now Jesus, rising from the synagogue, entered Simon's house. And Simon's mother-in-law was gripped by great fevers, and they asked Him on her behalf.
verses.4:39: And He stood over her and commanded the fever, and it left her. And rising at once, she served them.
verses.4:40: Now when the sun had set, all who had people sick with various ailments were bringing them to Him. And laying His hands on each one, He was healing them.
verses.4:41: And demons were coming out from many, shouting and saying, "You are the Son of God." And rebuking them, He would not permit them to speak, because they knew that He was the Christ.
verses.4:42: Now when day came, He left and went into a deserted place, and the crowds were seeking Him; and they came up to Him and were holding Him back so that He would not depart from them.
verses.4:43: To them He said, "To other cities also I must announce the good news of the kingdom of God, because for this reason I was sent."
verses.4:44: And He kept preaching in the synagogues of Galilee.
verses.5:1: Now it happened, when the crowds pressed upon Him to hear the word of God, that He Himself was standing beside the Lake of Gennesaret.
verses.5:2: And He saw two boats standing beside the lake, but the fishermen had disembarked and were washing the nets.
verses.5:3: Now boarding one boat, which was Simon's, He asked him to push out a little from the land. And sitting down, He was teaching the crowds from the boat.
verses.5:4: Now when He stopped speaking, He said to Simon, "Steer into the deep, and lower your nets for a catch."
verses.5:5: And answering, Simon said to Him, "Master, laboring through the whole night we caught nothing; yet at Your word I will lower the net."
verses.5:6: And when they had done this, they enclosed an abundant multitude of fish, and their net was tearing.
verses.5:7: And they signaled to the partners who were in the other boat to come and help them. And they came and filled both boats, so that they were nearly sinking.
verses.5:8: When Simon Peter saw this, he fell down at the knees of Jesus, saying, "Go away from me, because I am a sinful man, Lord."
verses.5:9: For astonishment had enveloped him, and all who were with him, at the catch of fish that they had caught;
verses.5:10: and likewise James and John, the sons of Zebedee, who were partners of Simon. And Jesus said to Simon, "Do not be afraid; from this time on you will be catching people."
verses.5:11: And when they had brought the boats to land, having left everything, they followed Him.
verses.5:12: And it happened, while He was in one of the cities, look, there was a man full of leprosy; and seeing Jesus and falling down on his face, he begged Him, saying, "Lord, if You are willing, You can cleanse me."
verses.5:13: And extending His hand, He touched him, saying, "I am willing; be cleansed." And at once the leprosy departed from him.
verses.5:14: And He Himself commanded him not to tell anyone, "But go, show yourself to the priest, and present an offering for your cleansing, just as Moses commanded, for a testimony to them."
verses.5:15: Yet the report about Him was circulating all the more, and large crowds were coming together to hear and to be cured of their illnesses.
verses.5:16: But He Himself would withdraw into the wilderness and pray.
verses.5:17: And it happened on one of the days that He Himself was sitting, teaching. And Pharisees were sitting there, and teachers of the law, who had come from every village of Galilee and Judea, and from Jerusalem; and the power of the Lord was present to heal them.
verses.5:18: And look, men were carrying on a bed a man who was paralyzed, and they were seeking to bring him in and place him before Him.
verses.5:19: And not finding by what way they might bring him in because of the crowd, they went up onto the roof, and through the tiles they lowered him with the bed into the middle before Jesus.
verses.5:20: When He saw their faith, He said, "Man, your sins are forgiven you."
verses.5:21: And the scribes and Pharisees began to think, saying, "Who is this who speaks blasphemies? Who is able to forgive sins, except God alone?"
verses.5:22: Now when Jesus knew their thoughts, answering, He said to them, "What are you thinking in your hearts?
verses.5:23: What is easier to say, 'Sins are forgiven you,' or to say, 'Rise and walk'?
verses.5:24: But so that you may know that the Son of Man has authority on earth to forgive sins," He said to the paralyzed man, "I say to you, rise, take up your bed, and go to your house."
verses.5:25: And at once rising up before them, he took up the bed on which he was lying, and went away to his house, magnifying God.
verses.5:26: And astonishment seized everyone, and they were magnifying God. And they were filled with fear, saying, "We have seen marvelous things today."
verses.5:27: And after these things He went out and saw a tax collector by the name of Levi, sitting at the tax office, and He said to him, "Follow Me."
verses.5:28: And having left everything, he rose up and followed Him.
verses.5:29: And Levi made a great banquet for Him in his house; and there was a large crowd of tax collectors and others who were reclining at table with them.
verses.5:30: And the Pharisees and their scribes were grumbling, saying to His disciples, "Why are you eating and drinking with tax collectors and sinners?"
verses.5:31: And answering, Jesus said to them, "Those who are healthy do not need a physician, but those who are unwell.
verses.5:32: I did not come to call the righteous, but sinners to repentance."
verses.5:33: But they said to Him, "Why do the disciples of John fast frequently and make supplications, and likewise those of the Pharisees, yet Yours eat and drink?"
verses.5:34: To them He Himself said, "Can you make the sons of the bridegroom fast while the bridegroom is with them?
verses.5:35: Yet the days will come when the bridegroom is taken away from them; then they will fast in those days."
verses.5:36: Now He was also telling a parable to them: "No one puts a patch from a new garment onto an old garment; otherwise he tears the new one as well, and the patch from the new does not match the old.
verses.5:37: And no one puts new wine into old wineskins; otherwise the new wine will burst the wineskins, and it will be poured out, and the wineskins will be destroyed;
verses.5:38: but new wine must be put into new wineskins, and both are preserved.
verses.5:39: And no one drinking the old immediately wants the new, for he says, 'The old is better.'"
verses.6:1: Now it happened on the second-first Sabbath, as He was passing through the grainfields, that His disciples were plucking heads of grain and eating them, rubbing them with their hands.
verses.6:2: But some of the Pharisees were saying to them, "Why are you doing what is not lawful on the Sabbaths?"
verses.6:3: And answering them, Jesus said, "Have you not even read this, what David did when he himself was hungry, and those who were with him,
verses.6:4: how he entered the house of God, and took the loaves of presentation, and ate, and gave to those who were with him, which it is not lawful to eat except for the priests alone?"
verses.6:5: And He was saying to them, "The Son of Man is Lord even of the Sabbath."
verses.6:6: Now it happened on another Sabbath that He entered the synagogue and taught. And a man was there, and his right hand was withered.
verses.6:7: Now the scribes and Pharisees were watching whether He would cure on the Sabbath, so that they might find grounds to accuse Him.
verses.6:8: But He Himself knew their thoughts, and He said to the man who had the withered hand, "Rise, and stand in the middle." And rising, he stood.
verses.6:9: Then Jesus said to them, "I ask you whether it is lawful on the Sabbaths to do good or to do evil, to save a life or to destroy it?"
verses.6:10: And having looked around at them all, He said to the man, "Stretch out your hand." And he stretched it out, and his hand was restored.
verses.6:11: But they themselves were filled with folly, and they were discussing with one another what they might do to Jesus.
verses.6:12: Now it happened in those days that He went out onto the mountain to pray, and He was spending the whole night in prayer to God.
verses.6:13: And when day came, He called His disciples, and He chose twelve from among them (whom He also named apostles):
verses.6:14: Simon, whom He surnamed Peter, and Andrew his brother, James and John, Philip and Bartholomew,
verses.6:15: Matthew and Thomas, James son of Alphaeus, and Simon, who is called the Zealot,
verses.6:16: and Judas son of James, and Judas Iscariot, who was a traitor.
verses.6:17: And coming down with them, He stood on a level place, along with a crowd of His disciples and a very large multitude of the people from all Judea, and Jerusalem, and the coastal region of both Tyre and Sidon,
verses.6:18: who had come to hear Him and to be healed from their ailments. And those who were troubled by unclean spirits were being cured.
verses.6:19: And the whole crowd was seeking to touch Him, because power was going out from Him and healing all of them.
verses.6:20: And He, having lifted up His eyes upon His disciples, was saying, "Blessed are the poor, because yours is the kingdom of God.
verses.6:21: Blessed are you who are hungry now, because you will be filled. Blessed are you who weep now, because you will laugh.
verses.6:22: Blessed will you be when people hate you, and when they exclude you, and reproach you, and cast out your name as evil on account of the Son of Man.
verses.6:23: Rejoice on that day and exult, for look, your reward is great in heaven; for in this same way their fathers acted toward the prophets.
verses.6:24: However, woe to you who are rich, because you have your consolation.
verses.6:25: Woe to you who have been filled, because you will be hungry. Woe to you who laugh now, because you will mourn and weep.
verses.6:26: Woe when people speak well of you, for in this same way their fathers acted toward the false prophets.
verses.6:27: But to you who hear, I say: love your enemies; do good to those who hate you.
verses.6:28: Bless those who curse you, and pray for those who slander you.
verses.6:29: And to the one who strikes you on the cheek, offer the other as well. And from the one who takes away your cloak, do not withhold even the tunic.
verses.6:30: Now to everyone who asks you, give; and from the one who takes away the things that are yours, do not ask for them back.
verses.6:31: And just as you want people to do to you, you also do likewise to them.
verses.6:32: And if you love those who love you, what thanks do you have? For even sinners love those who love them.
verses.6:33: And if you do good to those who do good to you, what thanks do you have? For indeed, even sinners do this.
verses.6:34: And if you lend to those from whom you hope to receive back, what thanks do you have? For even sinners lend to sinners so that they may receive back an equal amount.
verses.6:35: However, love your enemies, do good, and lend, hoping for nothing from it; and your reward will be great, and you will be sons of the Most High, because He Himself is kind toward the ungrateful and the evil.
verses.6:36: Be merciful, therefore, just as your Father also is merciful.
verses.6:37: Do not judge, and you will not be judged; do not condemn, and you will not be condemned. Forgive, and you will be forgiven.
verses.6:38: Give, and it will be given to you: a good measure, packed down and shaken together and overflowing, they will put into your lap. For with the same measure by which you measure, it will be measured back to you."
verses.6:39: Now He was also speaking a parable to them: "Can a blind man lead a blind man? Do they not both fall into a pit?
verses.6:40: A disciple is not above the teacher; but everyone will be perfect if he is like his teacher.
verses.6:41: Now why do you see the splinter in your brother's eye, yet do not consider the beam that is in your eye?
verses.6:42: Or how can you say to your brother, 'Brother, let me pull out the splinter from your eye,' when you yourself do not see the beam in your eye? Hypocrite, first pull out the beam from your eye, and then you will see clearly to draw out the splinter from your brother's eye.
verses.6:43: For there is no good tree that produces bad fruits, nor a bad tree producing good fruit.
verses.6:44: For each tree is known by its own fruit. For people do not gather figs from thorns, nor do they harvest grapes from a bramble bush.
verses.6:45: A good man brings out good from the good treasury of his heart, and an evil man brings out evil from the evil treasury. For from the abundance of the heart the mouth speaks.
verses.6:46: Now why do you call Me 'Lord, Lord,' and not do the things that I say?
verses.6:47: Everyone who comes to Me, and hears My words, and does them, I will show you whom he is like:
verses.6:48: he is like a man building a house, who dug deep and laid a foundation upon the rock; and when a flood came, the river dashed against that house and could not move it, for it had been founded upon the rock.
verses.6:49: But the one who hears and does not do so is like a man building his house upon the ground without a foundation, against which the stream dashed, and immediately it fell, and the ruin of that house was great."
verses.7:1: Now when He had completed all His words in the ears of the people, He entered Capernaum.
verses.7:2: Now a certain centurion's slave, being ill, was about to die, and he was precious to him.
verses.7:3: And when he had heard about Jesus, he sent elders of the Jews to Him, asking Him to come and save his slave.
verses.7:4: And when they had come to Jesus, they asked Him earnestly, saying to Him, "He is worthy that You should grant him this,
verses.7:5: for he loves our nation, and he himself built the synagogue for us."
verses.7:6: And Jesus was going with them. And when He was now not far from the house, the centurion sent friends to Him, saying, "Lord, do not trouble Yourself, for I am not worthy that You should enter under my roof;
verses.7:7: for which reason I did not even consider myself worthy to come to You; but speak with a word, and my servant will be healed.
verses.7:8: For I too am a man placed under authority, having soldiers under me; and I say to this one, 'Go,' and he goes; and to another, 'Come,' and he comes; and to my slave, 'Do this,' and he does it."
verses.7:9: When Jesus heard this, He was amazed, and turning to the crowds following Him, He said, "Amen, I tell you, not even in Israel have I found so great a faith."
verses.7:10: And when those who had been sent returned to the house, they found the slave, who had been sick, well.
verses.7:11: And it happened afterward that He was going to a city that is called Nain, and His disciples and a large crowd were going with Him.
verses.7:12: Now as He drew near to the gate of the city, look, a dead man was being carried out, the only son of his mother, and she was a widow; and a large crowd from the city was with her.
verses.7:13: And when the Lord saw her, moved with compassion for her, He said to her, "Do not weep."
verses.7:14: And He came up and touched the bier, and those who were carrying it stood still. And He said, "Young man, I say to you, rise."
verses.7:15: And the one who was dead sat up and began to speak. And He gave him to his mother.
verses.7:16: Now fear seized all of them, and they were magnifying God, saying, "A great prophet has risen among us, and God has visited His people."
verses.7:17: And this report about Him went out into all Judea and into all the surrounding region.
verses.7:18: And John's disciples reported to him about all these things.
verses.7:19: And John summoned two of his disciples and sent them to Jesus, saying, "Are You the One who is to come, or are we waiting for another?"
verses.7:20: And when the men had come to Him, they said, "John the Baptist sent us to You, saying, 'Are You the One who is to come, or are we waiting for another?'"
verses.7:21: Now in that very hour He cured many of illnesses and afflictions and evil spirits, and to many who were blind He granted sight.
verses.7:22: And answering, He said to them, "Go and report to John what you have heard and seen: that the blind see, the lame walk, lepers are cleansed, the deaf hear, the dead rise, the poor have good news proclaimed to them;
verses.7:23: and blessed is whoever is not caused to stumble because of Me."
verses.7:24: And when the messengers of John had departed, He began to speak to the crowds about John: "What did you go out into the desert to see? A reed shaken by the wind?
verses.7:25: But what did you go out to see? A man dressed in soft clothing? Look, those who are in costly clothing and luxury are in the houses of kings.
verses.7:26: But what did you go out to see? A prophet? Yes, I say to you, and more than a prophet:
verses.7:27: this is the one about whom it is written, 'Look, I send My messenger before Your face, who will prepare Your way before You.'
verses.7:28: For I say to you, among those born of women there is no prophet greater than John the Baptist; yet the one who is least in the kingdom of God is greater than he."
verses.7:29: And all the people who heard, and the tax collectors, justified God, having been baptized with the baptism of John.
verses.7:30: But the Pharisees and the experts in the law rejected the counsel of God for themselves, not having been baptized by him.
verses.7:31: And the Lord said, "What, then, should I say the people of this generation are like, and what are they like?
verses.7:32: They are like children sitting in the marketplace and speaking to one another and saying, 'We played the flute for you, and you did not dance; we lamented, and you did not weep.'
verses.7:33: For John the Baptist has come neither eating bread nor drinking wine, and you say, 'He has a demon.'
verses.7:34: The Son of Man has come eating and drinking, and you say, 'Look, a gluttonous man and one who drinks wine, a friend of tax collectors and sinners.'
verses.7:35: And wisdom has been justified by all her children."
verses.7:36: Now one of the Pharisees asked Him to eat with him. And having entered the Pharisee's house, He reclined at table.
verses.7:37: And look, a woman who was a sinner in the city, when she learned that He was reclining at table in the Pharisee's house, brought an alabaster jar of ointment;
verses.7:38: and standing behind Him at His feet, she began to wet His feet with tears, and she was wiping them with the hair of her head, and kissing His feet, and anointing them with the ointment.
verses.7:39: Now when the Pharisee who had invited Him saw this, he spoke within himself, saying, "If this man were a prophet, He would surely know who and what kind of woman this is who is touching Him, that she is a sinner."
verses.7:40: And answering, Jesus said to him, "Simon, I have something to say to you." And he said, "Teacher, say it."
verses.7:41: "A certain moneylender had two debtors: one owed five hundred denarii, and the other fifty.
verses.7:42: Since they had nothing with which to repay, he forgave both of them. Which of them, then, loves him more?"
verses.7:43: Answering, Simon said, "I suppose the one to whom he forgave more." And He said to him, "You have judged correctly."
verses.7:44: And turning toward the woman, He said to Simon, "Do you see this woman? I entered your house; you gave no water for My feet, but she has wet My feet with tears and wiped them with her hair.
verses.7:45: You gave Me no kiss, but she, from the time she entered, has not stopped kissing My feet.
verses.7:46: You did not anoint My head with oil, but she has anointed My feet with ointment.
verses.7:47: Therefore I say to you, many sins are forgiven her, for she has loved much. But the one to whom less is forgiven loves less."
verses.7:48: Then He said to her, "Sins are forgiven you."
verses.7:49: And those who were reclining at table together began to say within themselves, "Who is this who even forgives sins?"
verses.7:50: And He said to the woman, "Your faith has saved you; go in peace."
verses.8:1: And it happened afterward that He Himself was traveling through cities and villages, preaching and proclaiming the good news of the kingdom of God, and the twelve were with Him,
verses.8:2: and certain women who had been cured of evil spirits and illnesses: Mary, who is called Magdalene, out of whom seven demons had gone,
verses.8:3: and Joanna the wife of Chuza, Herod's steward, and Susanna, and many others, who were ministering to Him from their own means.
verses.8:4: Now when a very large crowd was gathering and people were hurrying to Him from the cities, He spoke through a parable:
verses.8:5: "The one who sows went out to sow his seed. And while he was sowing, some fell alongside the road, and it was trampled underfoot, and the birds of the sky ate it.
verses.8:6: And some fell on the rock, and when it sprouted, it dried up, because it had no moisture.
verses.8:7: And some fell among thorns, and the thorns sprang up together and choked it.
verses.8:8: And some fell into good soil, and growing up, it produced fruit a hundredfold." Saying these things, He cried out, "The one who has ears to hear, let him hear."
verses.8:9: Now His disciples were asking Him what this parable was.
verses.8:10: To them He said, "To you it has been given to know the mystery of the kingdom of God, but to the rest in parables, so that seeing they may not see, and hearing they may not understand.
verses.8:11: Now this is the parable: the seed is the word of God.
verses.8:12: And those alongside the road, these are the ones who hear; then the devil comes and takes away the word from their heart, so that they may not believe and be saved.
verses.8:13: For those on the rock are the ones who, when they hear, receive the word with joy; and these have no roots; they believe for a time, and in a time of testing they draw back.
verses.8:14: Now what fell into thorns, these are the ones who have heard, and as they go along, they are choked by anxieties, and riches, and pleasures of life, and they do not yield fruit.
verses.8:15: But what fell into good soil, these are the ones who, hearing the word in a good and excellent heart, hold it fast and bear fruit in patience.
verses.8:16: Now no one who lights a lamp covers it with a vessel or puts it under a bed, but puts it on a lampstand, so that those who enter may see the light.
verses.8:17: For there is nothing concealed that will not be revealed, nor anything hidden that will not be known and come into the open.
verses.8:18: Watch therefore how you hear. For whoever has, to him it will be given; and whoever does not have, even what he thinks he has will be taken away from him."
verses.8:19: Now His mother and brothers came to Him, and they could not reach Him because of the crowd.
verses.8:20: And it was reported to Him, "Your mother and Your brothers are standing outside, wanting to see You."
verses.8:21: Answering, He said to them, "My mother and My brothers are these, who hear the word of God and do it."
verses.8:22: Now it happened on one of the days that He Himself got into a boat with His disciples, and He said to them, "Let us cross over the lake." And they embarked.
verses.8:23: And as they were sailing, He fell asleep; and a windstorm came down onto the lake, and they were being flooded, and they were in danger.
verses.8:24: And approaching, they woke Him up, saying, "Master, we are perishing!" And rising up, He rebuked the wind and the tempest of the water, and it ceased, and there came a calm.
verses.8:25: Then He said to them, "Where is your faith?" And being afraid, they marveled to one another, saying, "Who do you suppose this is, that He commands even the winds and the sea, and they obey Him?"
verses.8:26: And they sailed to the region of the Gerasenes, which is opposite Galilee.
verses.8:27: And when He had stepped out onto the land, a certain man met Him who had already had a demon for a long time, and he wore no clothing, nor did he stay in a house, but in the tombs.
verses.8:28: When he saw Jesus, he fell down before Him, and crying out with a loud voice, he said, "What is there between me and You, Jesus, Son of the Most High God? I implore You, do not torment me."
verses.8:29: For He was commanding the unclean spirit to come out of the man. For many times it would seize him, and he was bound with chains and kept under guard with shackles. And having broken the bonds, he would be driven by the demon into deserted places.
verses.8:30: Then Jesus asked him, saying, "What is your name?" And he said, "Legion," because many demons had entered into him.
verses.8:31: And they were begging Him not to command them to go into the abyss.
verses.8:32: Now a herd of many pigs was feeding on the mountain there, and they begged Him to permit them to enter into them. And He permitted them.
verses.8:33: So the demons came out of the man and entered into the pigs, and the herd rushed headlong down the steep slope into the lake and was drowned.
verses.8:34: When the herdsmen saw what had happened, they fled and reported it in the city and in the countryside.
verses.8:35: And they went out to see what had happened, and they came to Jesus and found the man from whom the demons had gone out sitting, clothed and of sound mind, at His feet, and they were afraid.
verses.8:36: Those who had seen it also reported to them how he had been made well from the legion;
verses.8:37: and the whole multitude of the region of the Gerasenes begged Him to depart from them, because they were gripped by great fear. And getting into the boat, He Himself returned.
verses.8:38: And the man from whom the demons had gone out was begging Him that he might be with Him. But Jesus sent him away, saying,
verses.8:39: "Return to your house, and tell what great things God has done for you." And he went away throughout the whole city, proclaiming what great things Jesus had done for him.
verses.8:40: Now it happened that when Jesus had returned, the crowd welcomed Him, for they were all waiting for Him.
verses.8:41: And look, a man came whose name was Jairus, and he himself was a ruler of the synagogue; and he fell at the feet of Jesus, begging Him to come into his house,
verses.8:42: because he had an only daughter, about twelve years old, and she was dying. And it happened that while He was going, He was being pressed in on by the crowd.
verses.8:43: And a certain woman had a flow of blood for twelve years, who had spent all her livelihood on physicians and could not be cured by anyone;
verses.8:44: she came up from behind and touched the fringe of His garment, and immediately her flow of blood stopped.
verses.8:45: And Jesus said, "Who is it that touched Me?" And while all were denying it, Peter and those who were with him said, "Master, the crowds are pressing in on You and jostling You, and You say, 'Who touched Me?'"
verses.8:46: And Jesus said, "Someone touched Me, for I know that power has gone out from Me."
verses.8:47: Now when the woman saw that she had not escaped notice, she came trembling and fell down before His feet, and she declared in the presence of all the people for what reason she had touched Him, and how she had been healed immediately.
verses.8:48: And He said to her, "Daughter, your faith has saved you; go in peace."
verses.8:49: While He was still speaking, someone came to the ruler of the synagogue, saying to him, "Your daughter has died; do not trouble Him."
verses.8:50: But Jesus, having heard this word, answered the girl's father, "Do not be afraid; only believe, and she will be saved."
verses.8:51: And when He had come to the house, He did not permit anyone to enter with Him except Peter, James, and John, and the father and mother of the girl.
verses.8:52: Now all were weeping and mourning for her. But He said, "Do not weep; the girl is not dead, but is sleeping."
verses.8:53: And they were ridiculing Him, knowing that she had died.
verses.8:54: But He Himself, taking hold of her hand, called out, saying, "Girl, rise."
verses.8:55: And her spirit returned, and she rose at once. And He ordered that she be given something to eat.
verses.8:56: And her parents were astonished, and He commanded them not to tell anyone what had happened.
verses.9:1: Now after summoning the twelve apostles, He gave them power and authority over all demons and to cure illnesses.
verses.9:2: And He sent them to proclaim the kingdom of God and to heal the sick.
verses.9:3: And He said to them, "Take nothing on the road: neither a staff, nor a bag, nor bread, nor money; nor are you to have two tunics.
verses.9:4: And into whatever house you enter, remain there, and do not go out from there.
verses.9:5: And whoever does not receive you, when you go out from that city, shake off even the dust of your feet as a testimony against them."
verses.9:6: So having gone out, they went around through the villages, proclaiming the gospel and curing everywhere.
verses.9:7: Now Herod the tetrarch heard all the things that were being done by Him, and he was perplexed because it was being said
verses.9:8: by some that John had risen from the dead, and by some that Elijah had appeared, and by others that one of the ancient prophets had risen.
verses.9:9: And Herod said, "I myself beheaded John; yet who is this man about whom I hear such things?" And he was seeking to see Him.
verses.9:10: And when the apostles returned, they recounted to Him everything they had done; and taking them along, He withdrew privately into a deserted place that belongs to Bethsaida.
verses.9:11: When the crowds learned of this, they followed Him; and He welcomed them, and was speaking to them about the kingdom of God, and was healing those who were in need of a cure.
verses.9:12: Now the day had begun to decline, and the twelve came up and said to Him, "Send the crowds away, so that going into the villages and farms that are nearby, they may lodge and find provisions, for we are here in a deserted place."
verses.9:13: But He said to them, "You yourselves give them something to eat." And they said, "We do not have more than five loaves and two fish, unless perhaps we go and buy provisions for this entire crowd."
verses.9:14: Now there were about five thousand men. And He said to His disciples, "Have them recline in dining groups of fifty each."
verses.9:15: And they did so, and had them all recline.
verses.9:16: Now having taken the five loaves and the two fish, He looked up to heaven and blessed them; and He broke and distributed them to His disciples to set before the crowds.
verses.9:17: And all of them ate and were filled. And what remained over for them was taken up, twelve baskets of fragments.
verses.9:18: And it happened, while He was alone praying, that the disciples also were with Him; and He asked them, saying, "Who do the crowds say that I am?"
verses.9:19: But they answered and said, "John the Baptist; yet others, Elijah; and others, that one of the former prophets has risen."
verses.9:20: Then He said to them, "But you, who do you say I am?" Answering, Simon Peter said, "The Christ of God."
verses.9:21: But He, rebuking them, ordered them not to tell this to anyone,
verses.9:22: saying, "It is necessary for the Son of Man to suffer many things, and to be rejected by the elders and chief priests and scribes, and to be killed, and on the third day to rise again."
verses.9:23: Now He was saying to everyone, "If anyone wants to come after Me, let him renounce himself, and take up his cross every day, and follow Me.
verses.9:24: For the one who wants to save his life will lose it; for the one who loses his life on account of Me will save it.
verses.9:25: For how does a man benefit if he gains the entire world, yet loses himself and forfeits himself?
verses.9:26: For whoever is ashamed of Me and of My words, of this one the Son of Man will be ashamed when He comes in His majesty, and that of the Father, and of the holy angels.
verses.9:27: Now I say to you in truth: there are some standing here who will not taste death until they see the kingdom of God."
verses.9:28: Now it happened, about eight days after these words, that He took along Peter and James and John, and went up onto a mountain to pray.
verses.9:29: And while He was praying, the look of His face became different, and His attire became white and dazzling.
verses.9:30: And look, two men were talking with Him. Now they were Moses and Elijah,
verses.9:31: seen in majesty, and they were speaking of His departure, which He was about to fulfill in Jerusalem.
verses.9:32: Now Peter and those who were with him were weighed down with sleep; and waking up, they saw His majesty and the two men who were standing with Him.
verses.9:33: And it happened, as they were departing from Him, that Peter said to Jesus, "Master, it is good for us to be here, and let us make three tents, one for You, and one for Moses, and one for Elijah," not knowing what he was saying.
verses.9:34: Now while he was speaking these things, a cloud formed and overshadowed them; and they were afraid as they were entering into the cloud.
verses.9:35: And a voice came from the cloud, saying, "This is My beloved Son; listen to Him."
verses.9:36: And while the voice was sounding, Jesus was found alone. And they themselves remained silent, and in those days told no one anything of the things they had seen.
verses.9:37: Now it happened on the following day, as they were coming down from the mountain, that a large crowd met them.
verses.9:38: And look, a man from the crowd cried out, saying, "Teacher, I implore You, look upon my son, because he is my only child;
verses.9:39: and look, a spirit seizes him, and suddenly he cries out, and it dashes him down and convulses him with foaming, and scarcely departs, tearing at him;
verses.9:40: and I asked Your disciples to drive it out, and they were not able."
verses.9:41: And answering, Jesus said, "O unbelieving and perverse generation, how long will I be with you and endure you? Bring your son here."
verses.9:42: And as he was approaching, the demon dashed him down and convulsed him. And Jesus rebuked the unclean spirit, and healed the boy, and returned him to his father.
verses.9:43: Now all were astonished at the greatness of God; and while everyone was marveling at all the things He was doing, He said to His disciples, "You, place these words in your hearts; for the Son of Man is about to be handed over into the hands of men."
verses.9:45: Yet they did not comprehend this saying, and it was veiled before them so that they would not perceive it; and they were afraid to question Him about this saying.
verses.9:46: Now a thought entered into them as to which of them was the greatest.
verses.9:47: But Jesus, seeing the thoughts of their heart, took a child and placed him beside Himself,
verses.9:48: and said to them, "Whoever welcomes this child in My name receives Me, and whoever receives Me receives Him who sent Me. For whoever is least among all of you, this one is the greatest."
verses.9:49: Then John answered and said, "Master, we saw someone driving out demons in Your name, and we forbade him, because he does not follow with us."
verses.9:50: And Jesus said to him, "Do not forbid him, for whoever is not against you is for you."
verses.9:51: Now it happened, as the days of His being taken up were being fulfilled, that He Himself firmly set His face to go to Jerusalem.
verses.9:52: And He sent messengers ahead of Him; and as they went, they entered into a city of the Samaritans to make ready for Him.
verses.9:53: And they did not receive Him, because His face was that of one going to Jerusalem.
verses.9:54: Now when His disciples James and John saw this, they said, "Lord, do You want us to command that fire descend from heaven and consume them?"
verses.9:55: And turning around, He rebuked them, saying, "You do not know what spirit you are of.
verses.9:56: The Son of Man did not come to destroy lives, but to save them." And they went away to another village.
verses.9:57: Now it happened, as they were walking on the road, that someone said to Him, "I will follow You wherever You go."
verses.9:58: Jesus said to him, "Foxes have dens, and the birds of the sky have nests, but the Son of Man has nowhere to rest His head."
verses.9:59: Then He said to another, "Follow Me." Yet he said, "Lord, allow me first to go and bury my father."
verses.9:60: And Jesus said to him, "Let the dead bury their own dead; but you, go and announce the kingdom of God."
verses.9:61: And another said, "I will follow You, Lord, but allow me first to say farewell to what is at home."
verses.9:62: Jesus said to him, "No one setting his hand to the plow and looking back is suited for the kingdom of God."
verses.10:1: After these things, the Lord also designated seventy-two others and sent them in pairs ahead of Him into every city and place where He Himself was about to come.
verses.10:2: And He was saying to them, "The harvest indeed is abundant, but the workers are few. Ask the Lord of the harvest, therefore, to send workers into His harvest.
verses.10:3: Go; look, I am sending you like lambs among wolves.
verses.10:4: Do not carry a purse, nor a knapsack, nor sandals, and greet no one along the road.
verses.10:5: Into whatever house you enter, first say, 'Peace to this house.'
verses.10:6: And if a son of peace is there, your peace will rest on him; if not, it will return to you.
verses.10:7: Remain in that same house, eating and drinking what they have, for the worker is worthy of his wage. Do not move from house to house.
verses.10:8: And into whatever city you enter, and they receive you, eat what is placed before you,
verses.10:9: and cure the sick who are in it, and say to them, 'The kingdom of God has drawn near to you.'
verses.10:10: But into whatever city you enter, and they do not receive you, going out into its streets, say,
verses.10:11: 'Even the dust that clung to us from your city we wipe off against you; yet know this, that the kingdom of God has drawn near.'
verses.10:12: I tell you that for Sodom on that day it will be more bearable than for that city.
verses.10:13: Woe to you, Chorazin! Woe to you, Bethsaida! For if the deeds of power that were done in you had been done in Tyre and Sidon, long ago they would have repented, sitting in sackcloth and ashes.
verses.10:14: Nevertheless, for Tyre and Sidon it will be more bearable in the judgment than for you.
verses.10:15: And you, Capernaum, exalted up to heaven, will be plunged down to the underworld.
verses.10:16: The one who hears you hears Me, and the one who despises you despises Me; and the one who despises Me despises Him who sent Me."
verses.10:17: Now the seventy-two returned with joy, saying, "Lord, even demons submit to us in Your name."
verses.10:18: And He said to them, "I was watching Satan falling like lightning from heaven.
verses.10:19: Look, I have given you authority to trample upon serpents and scorpions, and over all the power of the enemy, and nothing will harm you.
verses.10:20: Nevertheless, do not rejoice in this, that the spirits submit to you; rejoice instead that your names are written in heaven."
verses.10:21: At that very hour He exulted in the Holy Spirit and said, "I praise You, Father, Lord of heaven and earth, because You have hidden these things from the wise and discerning and revealed them to little ones. Yes, Father, for so it was pleasing before You.
verses.10:22: All things have been delivered to Me by My Father. And no one knows who the Son is except the Father, and who the Father is except the Son and the one to whom the Son desires to reveal Him."
verses.10:23: And turning to His disciples, He said, "Blessed are the eyes that see the things you see.
verses.10:24: For I tell you that many prophets and kings desired to see the things you see, and did not see them, and to hear the things you hear, and did not hear them."
verses.10:25: And look, a certain expert in the law stood up, testing Him and saying, "Teacher, by doing what will I possess eternal life?"
verses.10:26: But He said to him, "In the law, what is written? How do you read it?"
verses.10:27: He answered and said, "You shall love the Lord your God with your whole heart, and with your whole soul, and with all your powers, and with all your mind, and your neighbor as yourself."
verses.10:28: And He said to him, "You have answered rightly; do this, and you will live."
verses.10:29: But wanting to justify himself, he said to Jesus, "And who is my neighbor?"
verses.10:30: Replying, Jesus said, "A certain man was going down from Jerusalem to Jericho and fell among robbers, who also stripped him and, after inflicting blows, went away, leaving him half dead.
verses.10:31: Now it happened that a certain priest was going down that same road, and upon seeing him, he passed by.
verses.10:32: Likewise a Levite also, when he was beside the place and saw him, passed on by.
verses.10:33: But a certain Samaritan who was traveling came beside him, and seeing him, he was moved with compassion.
verses.10:34: And approaching, he bandaged his wounds, pouring in oil and wine; and setting him on his own mount, he brought him to an inn and took care of him.
verses.10:35: And on the next day he brought out two denarii and gave them to the innkeeper, and said, 'Take care of him, and whatever more you spend, I myself will repay you when I return.'
verses.10:36: Which of these three seems to you to have been a neighbor to the one who fell among the robbers?"
verses.10:37: But he said, "The one who showed mercy to him." And Jesus said to him, "Go, and you do likewise."
verses.10:38: Now it happened, while they were going, that He Himself entered a certain village; and a certain woman named Martha welcomed Him into her house.
verses.10:39: And she had a sister named Mary, who also, sitting beside the Lord's feet, was listening to His word.
verses.10:40: But Martha was busying herself about continual serving; and she stood and said, "Lord, is it of no concern to You that my sister has left me to serve alone? Tell her, therefore, to help me."
verses.10:41: And the Lord answered and said to her, "Martha, Martha, you are anxious and troubled about very many things,
verses.10:42: yet one thing is necessary. Mary has chosen the best part, which will not be taken away from her."
verses.11:1: And it happened that while He was praying in a certain place, when He ceased, one of His disciples said to Him, "Lord, teach us to pray, just as John also taught his disciples."
verses.11:2: And He said to them, "When you pray, say, 'Father, may Your name be sanctified. May Your kingdom come.
verses.11:3: Give us today our daily bread.
verses.11:4: And forgive us our sins, since we ourselves also forgive everyone who is in debt to us. And do not bring us into temptation.'"
verses.11:5: And He said to them, "Which of you will have a friend, and will go to him at midnight, and will say to him, 'Friend, lend me three loaves,
verses.11:6: because a friend of mine has come to me from a journey, and I have nothing to set before him,'
verses.11:7: and he, answering from inside, should say, 'Do not bother me; the door is already closed, and my children are with me in bed; I cannot rise and give to you'?
verses.11:8: And if he persists in knocking, I tell you, even though he will not rise and give to him because he is his friend, yet because of his shamelessness he will rise and give him as many as he needs.
verses.11:9: And I tell you: Ask, and it will be given to you; seek, and you will find; knock, and it will be opened for you.
verses.11:10: For everyone who asks receives, and the one who seeks finds, and for the one knocking it will be opened.
verses.11:11: Now which of you asks a father for bread: will he give him a stone? Or for a fish: will he give him a snake instead of a fish?
verses.11:12: Or if he asks for an egg, will he hand him a scorpion?
verses.11:13: If then you, though you are evil, know how to give good gifts to your children, how much more will your Father from heaven give the good Spirit to those who ask Him?"
verses.11:14: And He was driving out a demon, and it was mute. And when He had driven out the demon, the mute man spoke, and the crowds marveled.
verses.11:15: But some of them said, "By Beelzebub, the ruler of the demons, He drives out demons."
verses.11:16: And others, testing Him, were seeking from Him a sign from heaven.
verses.11:17: But He, when He saw their thoughts, said to them, "Every kingdom divided against itself will be laid waste, and house will fall upon house.
verses.11:18: Now if Satan also is divided against himself, how will his kingdom stand? For you say that I drive out demons by Beelzebub.
verses.11:19: And if I drive out demons by Beelzebub, by whom do your sons drive them out? Therefore they themselves will be your judges.
verses.11:20: But if by the finger of God I drive out demons, surely the kingdom of God has come upon you.
verses.11:21: When an armed strong man guards his courtyard, the things that he possesses are in peace.
verses.11:22: But if one stronger than he comes upon him and conquers him, he will take away all his armor in which he was trusting, and will distribute his spoils.
verses.11:23: The one who is not with Me is against Me, and the one who does not gather with Me disperses.
verses.11:24: When an unclean spirit has gone out from a man, it walks through waterless places, seeking rest; and finding none, it says, 'I will return to my house from which I came out.'
verses.11:25: And when it arrives, it finds it swept clean and adorned.
verses.11:26: Then it goes and takes along with itself seven other spirits more wicked than itself, and having entered, they dwell there. And the final condition of that man becomes worse than the former."
verses.11:27: Now it happened, as He was saying these things, that a certain woman from the crowd, raising her voice, said to Him, "Blessed is the womb that carried You, and the breasts that You nursed!"
verses.11:28: But He said, "Rather, blessed are those who hear the word of God and guard it."
verses.11:29: Now as the crowds were gathering together, He began to say, "This generation is a wicked generation; it seeks a sign, and no sign will be given to it except the sign of Jonah the prophet.
verses.11:30: For just as Jonah was a sign to the Ninevites, so also will the Son of Man be to this generation.
verses.11:31: The queen of the South will rise in the judgment with the men of this generation and will condemn them, because she came from the ends of the earth to hear the wisdom of Solomon; and look, more than Solomon is here.
verses.11:32: The men of Nineveh will rise in the judgment with this generation and will condemn it, because they repented at the preaching of Jonah; and look, more than Jonah is here.
verses.11:33: No one lights a lamp and puts it in a hidden place, nor under a measuring basket, but on a lampstand, so that those who enter may see the light.
verses.11:34: The lamp of your body is your eye. If your eye is single, your whole body will be bright; but if it is wicked, your body also will be dark.
verses.11:35: See to it, then, that the light which is in you is not darkness.
verses.11:36: If therefore your whole body is bright, having no part of darkness, it will be bright as a whole, and like a lamp of brilliance it will illuminate you."
verses.11:37: And while He was speaking, a certain Pharisee asked Him to dine with him. And having entered, He reclined.
verses.11:38: Now the Pharisee, reflecting within himself, began to say why He had not washed before the meal.
verses.11:39: And the Lord said to him, "Now you Pharisees clean what is on the outside of the cup and the dish, but what is inside you is full of robbery and iniquity.
verses.11:40: Fools! Did not He who made what is on the outside also make that which is on the inside?
verses.11:41: Nevertheless, give what remains over as alms, and look, all things are clean for you.
verses.11:42: But woe to you, Pharisees, because you tithe mint and rue and every herb, and pass over justice and the love of God; yet these things you ought to have done, and not omitted those.
verses.11:43: Woe to you, Pharisees, because you love the foremost seats in the synagogues and greetings in the marketplace.
verses.11:44: Woe to you, because you are like tombs that are not visible, and people walking over them do not know."
verses.11:45: Then one of the experts in the law answered and said to Him, "Teacher, in saying these things You also insult us."
verses.11:46: But He said, "Woe also to you, experts in the law, because you burden people with burdens that they cannot carry, and you yourselves do not touch the loads with one of your fingers.
verses.11:47: Woe to you who build the tombs of the prophets, yet your fathers killed them.
verses.11:48: Surely you testify that you consent to the deeds of your fathers, for they indeed killed them, while you build their graves.
verses.11:49: For this reason the wisdom of God also said, 'I will send prophets and apostles to them, and some of them they will kill and persecute,
verses.11:50: so that the blood of all the prophets that was shed from the foundation of the world may be demanded from this generation,
verses.11:51: from the blood of Abel down to the blood of Zechariah, who perished between the altar and the sanctuary.' Yes, I tell you, it will be required from this generation.
verses.11:52: Woe to you, experts in the law, because you have taken away the key of knowledge; you yourselves did not enter, and you prevented those who were entering."
verses.11:53: Now while He was saying these things to them, the Pharisees and the experts in the law began to bear down heavily upon Him and to press upon His mouth about many things,
verses.11:54: lying in wait for Him, and seeking to catch something from His mouth, so that they might accuse Him.
verses.12:1: Now as many crowds were standing around, so that they were trampling on one another, He began to say to His disciples, "Watch out for the leaven of the Pharisees, which is hypocrisy.
verses.12:2: Yet nothing is covered over that will not be revealed, nor concealed that will not be known.
verses.12:3: For the things you have said in the darkness will be said in the light, and what you have spoken into the ear in the inner rooms will be proclaimed on the rooftops.
verses.12:4: Now I say to you, My friends, do not be terrified by those who kill the body and after these things have nothing further they can do.
verses.12:5: But I will show you whom you should fear: fear Him who, after He has killed, has authority to throw into Gehenna; yes, I say to you, fear Him.
verses.12:6: Are not five sparrows sold for a dupondius, and not one of them is forgotten before God?
verses.12:7: But even the hairs of your head have all been numbered. Therefore do not fear; you are worth more than many sparrows.
verses.12:8: Now I say to you, everyone who confesses Me before people, the Son of Man will also confess him before the angels of God;
verses.12:9: but the one who denies Me before people will be denied before the angels of God.
verses.12:10: And everyone who says a word against the Son of Man, it will be forgiven him; but to the one who blasphemes against the Holy Spirit, it will not be forgiven.
verses.12:11: Now when they bring you into the synagogues and before magistrates and authorities, do not be anxious about how or what you should answer, or what you should say.
verses.12:12: For the Holy Spirit will teach you at that very hour what you must say."
verses.12:13: Then someone from the crowd said to Him, "Teacher, tell my brother to divide the inheritance with me."
verses.12:14: But He said to him, "Man, who appointed Me a judge or a divider over you?"
verses.12:15: And He said to them, "Watch out and guard against all greed, for when anyone has an abundance, his life does not come from the things he possesses."
verses.12:16: Then He told a parable to them, saying, "The field of a certain rich man yielded abundant crops,
verses.12:17: and he was thinking within himself, saying, 'What should I do, because I have nowhere to gather my crops?'
verses.12:18: And he said, 'I will do this: I will tear down my barns and build larger ones, and there I will gather all the things that have grown for me, and my goods,
verses.12:19: and I will say to my soul, "Soul, you have many goods stored up for very many years; rest, eat, drink, feast."'
verses.12:20: But God said to him, 'Fool, this night they are demanding your soul back from you; now the things you prepared, whose will they be?'
verses.12:21: So it is with the one who stores up treasure for himself and is not rich toward God."
verses.12:22: And He said to His disciples, "For this reason I say to you, do not be anxious for your life, what you will eat, nor for the body, what you will put on.
verses.12:23: Life is more than food, and the body is more than clothing.
verses.12:24: Consider the ravens, for they do not sow or reap; they have neither storeroom nor barn, and God feeds them. How much more are you worth than they?
verses.12:25: And which of you by thinking can add one cubit to his stature?
verses.12:26: If then you cannot do even the smallest thing, why are you anxious about the rest?
